name: Link growth-studied strains to ribotype calls
description: Match each strain in a curated, versioned table of published growth experiments to the GenBank records from an earlier fetch_markers step by normalized strain or isolate name, and report the ribotype calls of those records with the responses each paper measured. Strains without a matching record, or whose records are unassigned or disagree, are reported as such. Runs locally with no source request.
planner_guidance: Call link_strains only after assign_ribotype completed for the same taxon and marker.
A curated growth strain table exists for Margalefidinium polykrikoides LSU only; other taxa and markers are refused.
A strain with no sequence record is a gap to report, not a failure.
A shared ribotype does not imply a shared growth response; report per-strain measurements.

arguments.name: taxon
arguments.description: The taxon of a completed assign_ribotype step.

arguments.name: marker
arguments.description: Marker of the completed assign_ribotype step.

sources: Curated growth strain table shipped with Sewall.ai; calls from an earlier assign_ribotype step

limitations: Strain names are matched after removing case, spaces and punctuation; a renamed or relabeled culture can be missed or mismatched.
Table entries were curated from abstracts or full text as each entry records; responses are not re-estimated.
Responses measured under different protocols are not directly comparable.

policy_constraints.attribution: Cite the strain table version, each strain's source publication, and the GenBank accessions linked.
